name: Simulation Techniques for Complex Fluids
description: Introduction to multiscale simulation methods. Description of complex fluid behavior. Simulation methods and their advantages and disadvantages. Multiscale computational modeling of complex fluids. Simulation tools to understand structure-property relationships in colloidal suspensions, polymers, granular materials, multiphase flows, and other classes of complex fluids. Application of machined learning for complex fluids modeling and simulations.
